rule: Post-cutoff flip pairs (D170). A pair is two CBP substantial-transformation rulings with one held origin each, at least one dated 2026-09-26 or later (eval/data/labels_final2.jsonl), on the same or a closely similar product, whose facts differ in the country where a component was made or an operation was done. 'before_after' and 'similar_product' pairs have different held origins (origin_changed true); 'control' pairs moved work but kept the origin. Tier 'core': same product type and the moved work is the main difference; 'edge': a different model or tool type, a second difference, or a swap between two third countries. Candidates were proposed by gemini-3.8-flash (eval/planner/mine.py) over BM25 neighbours of all 85 post-cutoff substantial-transformation rulings; every kept pair was read by hand (facts and holding of both rulings) and the reason is in its 'verification' field. 'family' is the product's own family check (D138, gemini-3.8-flash, bar 0.6) on variant A's facts (eval/results/planner-post-familycheck-litellm.jsonl); the plan search runs only where it found a template (fixtures in backend/testdata/planner_post/, written by hand from variant A's facts before any scoring). Frozen before any verifier or planner was scored on it; scored once with the production configuration.
rejected_candidates: Read and left out: garden stakes N364296/N364385 vs N365533/5/6 (different assembly countries, both held the assembly country); MIDI controller N366580 vs stream controller N362235 (different products, no shared move); gel pen N365984 vs N345964/N350091/N350095 (ink-cartridge country and assembly country both differ); NiTi tubes N365637 vs steel pipe N354423 (different products); LED fixtures N366342 vs N347800/N350325/N350433 (whole production in different countries); air-data instrument N365112 vs N351865/N353851 (different products); tool sets N365727 vs N355067/N362594 (set origin by essential character); shrimp, salmon and leather pairs (origin follows harvest or tanning, not a movable operation); near-duplicate windchimes N364881/N365793 and wrapping papers N365364-N365375 (one pair kept per product).
